use_case_summary: Enterprise RAG search over clinical documentation (progress notes, radiology reports, discharge summaries). Primary goal: high-recall retrieval with a lightweight reranker to surface top, clinically-relevant passages while maintaining PHI controls and full auditability.
requirements_summary: Indexing ~25M patient documents (expected 500M passages). Latency: retrieval+rerank P95 target <250ms for clinician UI workflows, higher latency allowed for batch analytics. Cost sensitivity for high-volume queries; require predictable pricing, autoscaling with burst capacity. Must support VPC/private endpoints, on-prem option for PHI-heavy datasets, SSO, audit logs, and KMS-managed keys. QoS: canary rollouts, per-route tracing, fallback to smaller models under contention.
indexing_scale: ~25M documents (~500M passages/tokens) initial POC; planning annual growth 3-4x.
latency_target: Retrieval+rerank P95 <250ms for interactive clinician search; background jobs can be minutes.
cost_per_query_target: $0.005 - $0.02 per query (depending on reranker complexity and batching).
reranking_strategy: Hybrid: dense embeddings (two-tower) for shortlist (top 200), then lightweight cross-encoder reranker for top-15; sensitive records optionally reranked on private on-prem nodes. Explore quantized CPU reranker for cost reduction and GPU for low-latency critical paths.
